description: This file defines the interface for the IpcModule class, which provides common IPC API functionalities for IPC modules within the Rialto client namespace. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and documentation comments, but no implementation details.

classes.name: IpcModule
classes.description: An abstract base class providing common IPC functionalities such as creating RPC stubs, subscribing to events, and managing IPC channels for derived IPC modules.

methods.name: IpcModule
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the IpcModule with a reference to an IIpcClient.

methods.name: ~IpcModule
methods.description: Virtual destructor for cleanup in derived classes.

methods.name: createRpcStubs
methods.description: Pure virtual method to create RPC stubs for the derived class, given an IPC channel.

methods.name: subscribeToEvents
methods.description: Pure virtual method to subscribe to IPC events for the derived class, given an IPC channel.

methods.name: unsubscribeFromAllEvents
methods.description: Method to unsubscribe from all IPC events associated with a given IPC channel.

methods.name: attachChannel
methods.description: Method to attach the IPC client channel to the module.

methods.name: detachChannel
methods.description: Method to detach the IPC client channel from the module.

methods.name: reattachChannelIfRequired
methods.description: Method to reattach the IPC channel if it is disconnected.
